name: Paperless-ngx

database.label: PostgreSQL recommended for production (SQLite works for small/single-user setups); Redis is a required broker

resourceFootprint.notes: 2 GB RAM / 2 cores handles typical scan-and-archive workloads. OCR (via Tesseract) is the main CPU cost during document consumption; add Tika + Gotenberg containers if you need Office-document conversion, which increases footprint further.

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  broker:
    image: docker.io/library/redis:8
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - redisdata:/data

  db:
    image: docker.io/library/postgres:17
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: paperless
      POSTGRES_USER: paperless
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: paperless

  webserver:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - db
      - broker
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fs", "-S", "--max-time", "2", "http://localhost:8000"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
    volumes:
      - data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
    environment:
      PAPERLESS_REDIS: redis://broker:6379
      PAPERLESS_DBHOST: db
      PAPERLESS_URL: https://paperless.example.com
      PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY: change-me
      PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE: Europe/Sofia
      PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE: eng

volumes:
  data:
  media:
  pgdata:
  redisdata:
descriptionEn: Paperless-ngx is a community-supported document management system that scans, OCRs, tags and archives all your paper documents so you can go (mostly) paperless. It automatically detects correspondents, tags and document types, and offers full-text search across your entire archive.
descriptionBg: Paperless-ngx е поддържана от общността система за управление на документи, която сканира, разпознава текст (OCR), тагва и архивира документите ти. Автоматично разпознава кореспонденти, етикети и типове документи, и предлага пълнотекстово търсене в целия архив.
taglineEn: Scan, OCR and archive your paperwork with full-text search.
taglineBg: Сканирай, разпознавай и архивирай документите си с пълнотекстово търсене.
